## PDF page 133

[Open source PDF](../../../../sources/pdf/GTO/Poker-Math-Preflop-Workbook.pdf#page=133)

```text
                                 RAISING


Now it is time to explore auto-profit when raising.

Each page contains a similar exercise, but this time you are facing a bet and
opt to raise. Complete each exercise the same way as the previous ones,
filling out the table for the five different raise sizes.

Remember that you can use the “3x + original pot” rule to figure out what a
pot-sized raise would be.

Again, these exercises are simplified since we are removing our hole cards
and making static continuance assumptions about our opponent’s range.
Even still, this is great practice and keeps you focused on how many raises
look to be auto-profitable with constrained variables.

Each time you find an auto-profit raise, pause for a moment and consider if
you have missed a similar bluff raising spot in your last few sessions.

GLGL.




                                      PA G E 1 3 3
```
